reason: I'm under a sink or on a roof half the day and every call I miss is a job that goes to the next guy. He sets it all up with me and I hear the test calls before it goes live, so I don't have to touch any software, and if it doesn't catch 10 calls I get the setup back.
objection: I'm scared it tells somebody the wrong thing or books them wrong and I lose the customer, and he's one guy with no plumber live on it yet to call. Two grand up front is real money even with the guarantee.
would_change_my_mind: If my own call log shows only a handful of missed calls, or if the French test call sounds like a robot or gets the no-heat call wrong, I walk away.
